login.deviceIntro1: On your phone (or any browser) open
login.pitch: Link your YouTube Music account to see your library, your playlists and your likes — just like the mobile app.
login.finePrint: "Link with your phone" shows a code you approve from your phone. "Sign in with Google" opens the real Google page in a secure window; your credentials never pass through this app.
onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to ERO'S Music
onboarding.welcome.body: Your YouTube Music, with a style of its own: backgrounds that react to what's playing, crossfade between songs, synced lyrics, downloads and much more.
onboarding.welcome.hint: The tour takes less than a minute. You can skip it anytime.
onboarding.tour.title: Your music, your way
onboarding.tour.search: Search any song, album or artist on YouTube Music
onboarding.tour.playlists: Your playlists and likes, synced with your account
onboarding.tour.sampleNote: The sample is real content from the app creator's collection — this is what ERO'S Music looks like with music inside.
onboarding.tour.samplePending: The content sample is not available in this build.
onboarding.theme.title: Pick your theme
onboarding.theme.body: Coffee Cream is the house theme, but there's a whole menu. Tap them to try them live — the entire app changes instantly.
onboarding.theme.note: preview only — to really change it, go to Settings → Appearance → Theme presets.
onboarding.life.title: No gaps between songs
onboarding.life.body: When a song ends, the next one blends in smoothly. If you turn on the reactive background, the colors travel with the mix.
onboarding.life.note: With Coffee Cream the colors stay fixed by design. To let the app breathe with your music, turn it on in Settings → Appearance → App background.
onboarding.login.title: Almost there
onboarding.login.body: You've seen what it's about. Sign in with your Google account to see your library, your playlists and your likes — just like on your phone.
onboarding.login.finePrint: "Sign in with Google" opens the real Google page in a secure window; your credentials never pass through this app.

settings.title: Settings
settings.playback.autoplay: Continue with radio when the queue ends (autoplay)
settings.playback.similar: Enable similar content (recommendations at the end of the queue)
settings.playback.shuffleFirst: Shuffle the list first, then load similar tracks
settings.playback.preload80: Preload more songs at 80% of the last track
settings.playback.noAutoloadRepeatAll: Don't auto-load more when repeating all
settings.playback.progressiveSeek: Progressive seek (each consecutive seek adds 5 s)
settings.playback.avoidDuplicates: Avoid duplicate tracks in the queue
settings.playback.rememberShuffle: Remember shuffle and repeat across sessions
settings.playback.persistentShuffle: Keep shuffle on when starting a new queue
settings.playback.autoDownloadOnLike: Cache when you like a song
settings.content.note: Language and country affect recommendations and search results. Changing them rebuilds the YouTube Music session on the fly.
settings.sources.note: The order in which the resolver will try each client when requesting audio. Check only the ones you want to use and adjust the priority with the arrows. Whenever a setting changes, the URL cache is cleared so the next track resolves with the new order.
settings.sources.ytdlpFallback: Use yt-dlp as a last resort
settings.source.desc.ytmusic: YouTube Music web (WEB_REMIX). Main authenticated client.
settings.source.desc.ios: iOS. Reliable as a fallback without a PoToken.
settings.source.desc.android: Android. High quality, ~2 MB without its own PoToken.
settings.source.desc.tvEmbedded: TV embed. Stable client as the last InnerTube option.
settings.lyrics.note: The order in which each lyrics provider is queried. The first one that returns actual content wins. Check only the ones you want to use and adjust the priority with the arrows.
settings.lyrics.desc.kugou: KuGou. Synced by line or by word (KRC).
settings.stats.note: Stats are computed only from your local history (SQLite). Nothing leaves your computer. The Recap page opens from Home or by navigating to Recap.
settings.stats.showRecapCard: Show the Recap card on Home
settings.home.note: Adjust how the Home screen looks: shuffle shelves, choose which quick-pick chips appear on top, and reorder or hide the shelves YouTube Music returns.
settings.home.quickPicksHint: Quick picks (chips shown above the large cards)
settings.artist.showMonthly: Show monthly listeners (if the provider exposes them)
settings.tooltip.crossfade: Blends the end of a track with the start of the next one over the number of seconds shown.
settings.tooltip.shuffleFirst: When shuffle is on, mixes up the current queue first before adding similar songs.
settings.tooltip.preload80: Starts loading the next song once the current one hits 80%, to avoid gaps.
settings.tooltip.noAutoloadRepeatAll: With 'repeat all' on, no new songs are added automatically once the list finishes.
settings.tooltip.gaplessNoCrossfade: If tracks are from the same gapless album, turns off crossfade so they don't overlap.
settings.tooltip.progressiveSeek: Lets you jump to any point in a song while it's still downloading.
settings.tooltip.avoidDuplicates: Stops the same song from showing up twice in a row in the queue.
settings.tooltip.skipOnError: If a song fails to load, skips to the next one automatically instead of stopping playback.
settings.tooltip.rememberShuffle: Keeps your shuffle and repeat state between sessions, even after closing the app.
settings.tooltip.persistentShuffle: Keeps the same shuffled queue order even if you switch songs or restart the app.
settings.tooltip.autoDownloadOnLike: Songs you like are automatically downloaded so you can play them offline. Files are stored in an internal app cache and are not accessible as standalone music files.
settings.tooltip.streamingSources: Sets which internal YouTube Music client the app uses to search and play. Only change it if you're having playback issues.
settings.tooltip.ytdlpFallback: If no streaming source works, falls back to yt-dlp as a last resort to fetch the audio.
settings.tooltip.lyricsOrder: The order the app tries each lyrics provider in until it finds a match.
settings.tooltip.topLength: How many songs/artists the weekly and monthly 'top' recap includes.
settings.tooltip.shelvesEditor: Reorder the sections (shelves) shown on the Home screen, or hide the ones you don't want to see.
settings.tooltip.equalizer: Manually adjust the volume of each frequency range (bass to treble) to shape the sound.
settings.tooltip.preamp: Raises or lowers the overall volume before the equalizer is applied, to offset band peaks or dips.
settings.tooltip.pauseOnDeviceChange: Automatically pauses playback if you unplug your headphones or switch output speakers.
settings.tooltip.network: Sets up a network proxy for the app's connections. Only needed if you use a VPN or have network restrictions.
settings.tooltip.proxyServer: Proxy server address in host:port format. Only used when the proxy mode is HTTP or SOCKS5.
settings.downloads.note: Add your own music here (files you already own). The app indexes them automatically and creates a "Local Music" playlist. You can pick any location, including an external drive.
settings.themes.title: Theme presets
settings.themes.note: Fixed color palettes for the whole app. The accent color is still chosen above; press a classic theme ("Dark", "Black", "Light") to go back to the normal look.
settings.themes.pressAgain: · press it again to remove it.
settings.bg.note: "Ambient" tints the background with the album colors (60-30-10 split) and drifts gently. "Reactive" also breathes with the song's rhythm.
settings.accent.dynamicTitle: The accent follows the artwork of the song now playing
settings.integrations.discord: Discord Rich Presence (show what you're listening to on Discord)
settings.integrations.discordNote: Requires the Discord app to be open. Shows up as "Listening to YouTube Music" with title, artist, artwork and progress.
settings.system.closeToTray: Keep running in the system tray when closing the window
settings.system.pauseOnDeviceChange: Pause when the audio device changes (headphones/speakers)
settings.network.note: Applies to InnerTube, downloads and all app networking.
